title: Causal completion recovery still collapses batch and settlement failures into generic reasons
outcome: When the causal-completion recovery worker's batch read fails, or a settlement's read, validation or publication fails, the original row (or a bounded worker diagnostic, when no row can be identified) names a typed stage for that failure instead of the generic pending_read_failed log line or the AdmissionFailed reason.
acceptance: Causal completion recovery still collapses batch and settlement failures into generic reasons is done
